principles: Only fix the correctness proof gap exposed by baseline item 5.
Delivery-check freshness must follow existing Lattice materialHash semantics.
Fail closed for missing/tampered gate evidence bindings.
Keep delivery reviewer role separation unchanged.
drivers: Gate-consumed delivery-check evidence must not pass over changed source material.
Metadata-only commits should not create arbitrary delivery-review rerun loops.
Process-fact/artifact contracts must remain consistent for L4 delivery-check evidence.

options.name: materialHash-binding-with-headHash-audit
pros: Catches real material drift after delivery review
Avoids arbitrary reruns for metadata-only head changes
Keeps fix narrow to delivery-check contract/gates
cons: Older delivery-check artifacts without materialHash become stale and must be rerun

options.name: headHash-and-materialHash-hard-binding
pros: Strictly binds delivery-check to exact commit
cons: Would force reruns after harmless Lattice metadata-only commits
Conflicts with existing done-required metadata-only head drift behavior

options.name: status-only-warning
cons: Leaves DONE able to accept stale delivery evidence
Does not fix the correctness issue

rationale: Use materialHash as the hard freshness contract and keep headHash as audit metadata. That fixes stale source-material delivery evidence without inventing a broad optimization or destabilizing metadata-only closure workflows.

preMortem.scenario: Older delivery-check files without materialHash still pass
preMortem.trigger: DONE gate only checks _hash and docsPromises
preMortem.mitigation: Gate helper treats missing materialHash as stale and tests assert fail-closed behavior

preMortem.scenario: Metadata-only commits force unnecessary delivery reviewer reruns
preMortem.trigger: headHash is enforced as a hard binding
preMortem.consequence: DONE closure loops after Lattice metadata writes
preMortem.mitigation: Record headHash for audit only; freshness compares materialHash

preMortem.scenario: Hash signature ignores the new binding
preMortem.trigger: materialHash field is added but not included in signDeliveryCheck
preMortem.consequence: A stale or forged binding can be edited without tamper detection
preMortem.mitigation: Include materialHash in signature domain and add tamper regression assertions

preMortem.trigger: Delivery-check artifact contract changes without registry/contract validation
preMortem.consequence: Reviewers cannot rely on L4 gate evidence provenance
preMortem.mitigation: Focused smoke asserts delivery-check remains L4 gate evidence produced by delivery_check_set and full process-fact contract validation passes
